_README: How a practice exam is composed, per bank, so a session mirrors the real paper
instead of drawing at random across subjects.
`subject` must match the middle field of a question's `origin` exactly. build.py
validates every entry against the built banks and FAILS if a subject is missing or
has fewer questions than `count` — a typo here would otherwise silently produce a
`pass_mark` is per subject, as the real exams require: passing overall while failing
one subject is still a fail, so the results page scores each subject separately.
A bank with no entry here (cfa_fra) falls back to drawing QUIZ_SIZE at random.
`note` is shown to the user on the results page, so keep it in Traditional Chinese.
